operator.pairing.gesture.mac.role: Phone pairing (approve a phone from this computer)
operator.pairing.gesture.mac.note: Shown on the desktop pairing card just before the macOS admin/Touch ID prompt. Must say it is the Mac's own password, NOT the Radient account password (D13).

operator.pairing.gesture.windows.role: Phone pairing (approve a phone from this computer)

operator.pairing.gesture.other.role: Phone pairing (approve a phone from this computer)

operator.pairing.prompt.confirm.role: Phone pairing (approve a phone from this computer)
operator.pairing.prompt.confirm.note: Text inside the macOS administrator-password dialog when confirming (adding) a phone. Keep it one sentence; no quotes (it is embedded in AppleScript).

operator.pairing.prompt.remove.role: Phone pairing (approve a phone from this computer)
operator.pairing.prompt.remove.note: macOS administrator-password dialog text when REMOVING a phone. One sentence; no double quotes.

operator.pairing.prompt.setup.role: Phone pairing (approve a phone from this computer)
operator.pairing.prompt.setup.note: macOS administrator-password dialog text when turning on phone approvals (operator authority setup). One sentence; no double quotes.

operator.pairing.refusal.confirm_needs_c.role: Phone pairing (approve a phone from this computer)
operator.pairing.refusal.confirm_needs_c.note: Desktop refusal: the request was not verified as coming through the owner's Radient account, so the person must type the phone's six-digit code instead of tapping 'Codes match'.

operator.pairing.refusal.request_changed.role: Phone pairing (approve a phone from this computer)
operator.pairing.refusal.request_changed.note: Desktop refusal: the pairing card's content changed between rendering and the decision.

operator.pairing.refusal.unknown_request.role: Phone pairing (approve a phone from this computer)
operator.pairing.refusal.unknown_request.note: Phone-facing: the pairing request id it asked about does not exist.

operator.pairing.refusal.withdraw_invali.role: Phone pairing (approve a phone from this computer)

operator.pairing.refusal.withdraw_forbid.role: Phone pairing (approve a phone from this computer)
operator.pairing.refusal.withdraw_forbid.note: Phone-facing: the cancel was signed by a different phone key.

operator.pairing.refusal.in_progress.role: Phone pairing (approve a phone from this computer)
operator.pairing.refusal.in_progress.note: Phone-facing: the computer is already signing/confirming; the phone cannot cancel now.

operator.pairing.refusal.bad_device_id.role: Phone pairing (approve a phone from this computer)
operator.pairing.refusal.bad_device_id.note: Desktop refusal for a malformed phone id in Remove.

operator.pairing.revoke.unfinished.role: Phone pairing (approve a phone from this computer)
operator.pairing.revoke.unfinished.note: Terminal message after `lop operator devices --revoke` when the OS prompt was cancelled: the phone is blocked but the privileged step is unfinished.
